title: Choose the new look for BizEazy Hub (more modern)
question: The roll assigned the order-tracking world. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Order Tracker
options.lineage: the live order tracking every restaurant owner watches in delivery apps
options.thesis: Every invoice, quote and payslip moves like an order you're tracking: placed, on its way, done.
materials: step trackers that fill as things progress
bottom sheets that rise from the thumb
options.viewport: A live 'This month' card on top: RM collected large, owed beneath, one bar from invoiced to collected. Below, 'Needs you' cards each with a step tracker (Salary Sept: generated, sent, paid · 2 days left). A chilli-red New button opens a bottom sheet: invoice, quote, payslip.
options.risk: Borrowing app grammar can feel generic if the step trackers and live cards are done half-heartedly.

raised.raise: Status is a mark in a fixed cell: filled is done, hollow is not yet, in the same positions on every record.
Every amount sits right-aligned in tabular figures, so money lines up like a tally.
Lists reflow in whole cards, never squeezed columns, at every width.

options.label: Payment Confirmed
options.lineage: e-wallet and DuitNow QR payment screens
options.thesis: Every number is a receipt you can trust at a glance, as clear as a payment-success screen.
options.viewport: RM owed and collected as two huge amounts on a blue field, a to-do list beneath, quick actions as round icon buttons.
options.risk: The familiar fintech look; blue and white edges toward the bank feeling you said would be wrong.

options.label: Guide Map
options.thesis: Each part of the business is a flat colour region you step into.
options.viewport: A green Money region swells across the screen with capsule buttons pinned to its edge.
options.case: Modern, friendly and memorable; loses on clarity because shapes compete with figures.
options.risk: Can read playful, close to the childish feel you ruled out.

options.label: Graphite Console
options.thesis: A calm graphite workspace with hairline seams and panels that stay put.
options.viewport: Panels for money, needs-you and quick actions tiled across a dark surface.
options.case: Great for month-end desk work; loses on recognition and on reading in a bright restaurant.
options.risk: Dark-first is hard in daylight and feels like a developer tool.

options.label: Timetable Rack
options.thesis: One type size; rank carried by weight and case.
options.case: Too stylised for quick money checks.
options.kept: Status as a filled or hollow mark in a fixed cell.

options.label: Mixtape Card
options.thesis: Totals tallied tight to the margin.
options.kept: Right-aligned tabular amounts that line up like a tally.

options.label: Event Catalog Grid
options.thesis: Thousands of stamp-size cells in one grid.
options.case: Too dense: cramped is what you ruled out.
options.kept: Lists reflow in whole cards, never squeezed.

canonCard.label: Modern business-app standard
canonCard.thesis: What well-made business apps ship: clean, calm, familiar.
canonCard.viewport: Summary cards for owed and collected, a to-do list, and buttons for quick actions.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other business app by design.
